name: Rowan Boateng
location: the Gray Zone — lower district tenements near the old lakeshore, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Rowan Boateng is stocky and solid, with hands that look like they were built for breaking things and a face that confirms it. At 29, his expression defaults to a careful neutrality that took years of practice to maintain. The chrome is visible — synthetic blood with oxygen-carrying nanites — doesn't tire, heals faster — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He used to be somebody else, in another city, with another name — that person is officially dead, and Rowan Boateng plans to keep it that way. He works as a ghost out of the Gray Zone, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Rowan Boateng has built a reputation on reliability rather than flash — he shows up, he delivers, he collects.

core_fears: Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
core_desires: Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
coping_mechanisms: Denial — nothing is wrong, everything is fine, they are fine, shut up
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Cannot see that their independence is actually isolation wearing a better outfit
Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
psychology.secret: Hadiya Chen-Adeyemi has been doubling fees to clients and pocketing the difference. The fixer who handles their contracts doesn't know. Yet.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, technical, stripped of ornament. Speaks like a mission briefing.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Swears in three languages, often in the same sentence
Refers to killing as 'solving' — clinical detachment as coping mechanism
example_lines: "Clean means no witnesses, no evidence, no questions. That's three things. I charge for each."
"The target will stop breathing at the specified time. What you do with that information is your concern."

story_hooks: Hadiya Chen-Adeyemi discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
A dead drop Hadiya Chen-Adeyemi maintains is found and cleaned out — whoever did it now has leverage
Hadiya Chen-Adeyemi is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
narrative_function: Hadiya Chen-Adeyemi functions as a connector — his work puts him in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving him naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Synthetic blood with oxygen-carrying nanites — doesn't tire, heals faster. Bone lacing — titanium mesh throughout skeleton, increases durability and striking power
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.
affiliation: Unaffiliated — too volatile for permanent crews

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
ability to remain calm under fire

decision_rules: Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
habits: Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
breaking_points: Being forced to choose between a crew member and the mission — and choosing wrong
Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap
A child being put in danger as leverage against them

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly Sub-Saharan African (53.8%) with significant Northern European (24.7%), South Asian (18.3%), and Southeast Asian (3.2%) ancestry. This creates a striking phenotype: rich deep brown skin with warm golden undertones, angular facial structure with prominent cheekbones from South Asian lineage blended with the broad, powerful features of Sub-Saharan African genetics. Northern European ancestry contributes lighter undertones and a slightly sharper nose bridge, while Southeast Asian ancestry adds subtle refinement to the overall bone structure. The result is a rare confluence of robust strength and distinctive angular elegance.
physical_description.build: Stocky and densely muscled, broad-shouldered with a thick core. Heavy in the way that suggests practical strength rather than aesthetic bulk — the build of someone who trains for impact and durability, not display.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with premature silver threading at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, functional. Kept short enough that it requires minimal maintenance and won't obstruct vision or provide a target to grab.
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich deep warm brown with golden undertones, the dominant Sub-Saharan African ancestry darkened and warmed by natural melanin concentration, brightened subtly by Northern European and South Asian admixture
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and angular — prominent cheekbones and squared jaw characteristic of South Asian and Sub-Saharan African heritage merged, with broad strong features from African ancestry refined by the higher cheekbones of South Asian genetics. A scar tissue webbing the right side of his chin, white against darker skin. Skin is clear but shows the wear of someone who trains hard and heals fast. No vanity grooming — pragmatic maintenance only.
distinguishing_marks: Jagged scar tissue across the right mandible, roughly 8cm in length, white against darker skin
Thin horizontal scar above the left eyebrow, approximately 3cm
Knuckle scarring across both hands — old, healed white lines indicating repeated impact trauma
Faint stippled burn marks across the inner left forearm, roughly 4cm diameter, consistent with a contact wound or sustained heat exposure
physical_description.visible_augmentations: The synthetic blood is his signature — visible as a faint bioluminescent shimmer beneath the skin at pulse points (wrists, neck, temples), most noticeable in low light. The glow is a dull crimson-violet, rhythmic but subtle. No attempt to conceal it. The titanium bone lacing is subcutaneous and invisible, but the increased density and straightness of his posture, the precision of his movements, and the way he absorbs impact hints at skeletal reinforcement to trained eyes.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and controlled. He moves with the precision of someone who has internalized that every motion is a statement. No wasted gestures. When still, he is absolutely still — no fidgeting, no micro-expressions. When moving, each step is deliberate and weighted. His hands rest in neutral positions, ready but not threatening. He doesn't flinch.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian. Black tactical pants with reinforced knee and thigh panels, worn synthetic leather bomber jacket over a fitted grey compression shirt that allows augmentation visibility without advertising it. Steel-toed boots, scuffed but maintained. No logos, no flash — all function. A single worn silver chain around his neck, visible augmentation access ports deliberately left unhidden. The overall impression is someone who dresses for work, not for appearance.
